name: Sun-aligned Relighting TensoRF
aliases: Fast Sun-aligned Outdoor Scene Relighting based on TensoRF
definition: A method for outdoor scene relighting that eliminates the need for environment maps by using sun direction as a direct input for shadow generation, leveraging TensoRF's efficiency and adding a cubemap for unbounded scenes.
summary: Sun-aligned Relighting TensoRF is an outdoor scene relighting method that uses sun direction as input to generate dynamic shadows, eliminating the need for environment maps.
